title: Why Testing Matters
description: Learn the benefits of testing and how to set up pytest.

slides.title: Tests = Safety Net 🧪
slides.content:
# Why Test?

- Catch bugs early
- Refactor with confidence
- Serve as documentation
- Ensure requirements are met

FastAPI integrates with **pytest** – a powerful testing framework.

slides.title: First Test
slides.content:
Install pytest: `pip install pytest`

Write a simple test file `test_main.py`

quizData.question: What is a primary benefit of automated testing?

options.text: It makes the code run faster
It helps catch bugs before deployment
It replaces the need for documentation

quizData.explanation: Tests validate that your code behaves as expected, reducing the chance of bugs in production.
